data_gaps.gap: Ixx, Iyy, Izz at nacelle angles 15, 30, 45, 60, 75 deg are not tabulated in the reviewed sources.
No explicit closed-form source equation for aircraft inertia as a function of nacelle angle was found.
Full numeric CL(alpha), CD(alpha), and Cm(alpha) tables/arrays are not present in the supplied extraction; curve plots and metadata alone are insufficient for a source-faithful lookup table.
Digitized coordinates from NASA CR-166536 Figures 8, 11, 15, and other relevant figures remain to be extracted and independently checked.
The 60-knot wake-interference boundary is reported from a summary record; inspect the full report before coding a hard cutoff.
Moving pylon/nacelle/rotor assembly centre of mass, own-axis inertia tensor, and mass breakdown needed for a defensible angle-dependent inertia calculation are missing.
Conversion spindle station line and water line, baseline CG water line, and full component-to-aircraft coordinate definitions are not numerically available in the reviewed extraction.
I_xz is not reported in the extracted endpoint table at 0 or 90 degrees; other products of inertia are also not supplied.

NASA CR-166536 reportedly flags XV-15 inertias as outdated due to omitted airframe modifications and flight-test instrumentation mass/location; applicability to the intended simulation configuration must be resolved.
NASA TM-89428 quantitative pitch/yaw inertia findings need exact page/table and original-source verification; supplied audit notes omitted nose/tail ballast as a cause of mismatch.
Lanham (1979), ASD-TR-79-5004, is cited by NASA CR-166536 but is absent from reviewed sources; retrieve it to determine the documented method and required inputs.
Bell Helicopter Report 301-199-002 and NASA CR-166537 are suggested leads for source data/software implementation but have not been accessed or verified.
Nominal CG waterline coordinate not verified. Required for a complete 3D mass-property reference.
Moments and products of inertia at intermediate nacelle angles are unavailable. A documented component-based transformation method and component mass properties are needed.
Pylon spindle station and waterline coordinates are unverified.
Verified rotor thrust and torque coefficient data, blade pitch distribution, and sufficient aerodynamic inputs are missing.
Complete numerical CL(alpha), CD(alpha), and Cm(alpha) tables and their control-deflection dependencies are missing.
Verified derivatives or mappings from actuator deflections to aircraft forces and moments are missing.
Exact three-dimensional rotor hub positions relative to the aircraft reference frame are unavailable.
